messages:
elaine: Quick async sync on private deploy roadmap. Main goals: packaging profiles, upgrade lanes, and customer-managed networking. Short thread pls.
jasper: Happy to run. Can we list decisions needed before the customer workshop next week?
elaine: Yes Need clarity on installer profiles (thin vs ops), expected upgrade downtime, and where netops needs to step in.
maria: Field notes: customers want a "thin" installer (no relay, rely on customer egress) and an "ops" installer (relay + support hooks). Also ask for allowlist guidance.
frank: Upgrade ask from customers: in-place patching without full rebootstrap. We should confirm operator compatibility for KV cache and schema migrations.
jasper: Current engineering stance: minor patches = rolling operator upgrades (CRD-aware), expected node-level interruption ~30s rolling; major schema changes = bundle swap + maintenance window. Need to validate with SRE.
netops: For networking we categorize: 1) relay-managed (we provide public egress), 2) customer-nat (outbound-only), 3) airgapped. Each has different expectations for inbound, DNS, and IP allowlists.
elaine: Proposed roadmap: Q3 alpha = thin + relay toggle, preflight checks, allowlist doc; Q4 = minor in-place upgrades with canary+auto-revert; Q1 = documented major upgrade runbook. Feedback?
maria: Field wants CLI-first installer UX. Also pilot customers asked for a flag to opt-out of relay and a short allowlist snippet to hand to their NetOps.
frank: Example thin profile snippet for the installer:
```
installer.profile: thin
network.mode: customer-nat
egress.allowlist: ["<customer-egress-ip>"]
operator.upgrade.strategy: rolling
```
jasper: Add preflight that validates: outbound IPs, DNS resolution for control-plane, TLS handshake to control endpoints, and operator RBAC checks. Fail preflight with explicit remediation steps.
netops: We'll produce a NetOps checklist for customers: required egress endpoints, TLS SNI expectations, port 443 egress test, and ephemeral port behavior. Share as a single-page doc.
maria: Upgrade policy ask: staged canary size (suggest 1 node or 5% tenants), automated revert on error spikes, and a revert token to force rollbacks.
frank: Note: KV cache compatibility only guaranteed for minor semver bumps. Major requires an explicit migration step and operator-runbook. We'll include migration hooks in the runbook.
elaine: Draft launch criteria: 1) thin + ops installer profiles implemented; 2) preflight checks + docs; 3) minor upgrade validated in staging with canary + rollback; 4) network toggle + allowlist guidance reviewed by security; 5) major upgrade runbook drafted.
jasper: Timeline: can deliver Q3 alpha for 1,2,4 (experimental CLI); Q4 for 3 (canary + revert automation); Q1 for 5. Need legal/security sign-off on allowlist wording.
maria: I'll recruit 3 pilot customers for the Q3 alpha. CLI-first ok.
frank: I'll prototype the revert token flow and a concise runbook snippet for majors/minors.
deploy-bot: Created Jira RDW-privdeploy-202 for "thin/ops profiles + preflight checks".
elaine: Action items: jasper - installer templates + preflight checks (1w); frank - major/minor upgrade runbook & revert token prototype (2w); maria - recruit pilots (2w); netops - internal checklist for customers (1w).
jasper: No infra blockers. Will post PR with templates by EOD Fri.
maria: Field ok with CLI-first; scheduling pilots now.
frank: Sharing rollback snippet later this week.
elaine: Thanks everyone  will update roadmap doc and ping security/legal re allowlist wording. Flag blockers here. :thumbsup:
